Package com.nexuslink.security.cert

Class CertificateStore

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.security.cert.CertificateStore
public final class CertificateStore extends Object
A keystore-backed certificate store (PKCS12 by default, JKS supported). Wraps a JCA KeyStore with simple list / import / export / delete operations and disk persistence, so the certificate manager can keep a user's trusted certs and self-signed key pairs in one password-protected file.
